en.q: In an oscillating spring mass system, a spring is connected to a box filled with sand. As the box oscillates, sand leaks slowly out of the box vertically so that the average frequency ω(t) and average amplitude A(t) of the system change with time t. Which one of the following options schematically depicts these changes correctly?
o: [ω rises and levels off; A constant]
[ω rises and levels off; A falls and levels off]
[ω rises and levels off; A rises and levels off]
[ω falls and levels off; A falls and levels off]
